nodes.description: msg.sender / _msgSender(): caller address used for whitelist recovery, holder checks, per-wallet mint key and owner checks
block.timestamp: miner-influenced timestamp mixed into the pseudo-random number generator
MintConfig mintConfig: startIndex, endIndex, remaining, mintPrice, limits, version, flags and whitelistSigner
mapping(string => uint) mintedPerWallet: number of tokens minted per wallet+version key
mapping(uint => uint) mintCache: shuffled-index cache used by the random mint strategy
uint totalSupply: number of live tokens
uint minted: cumulative mint counter used as sequential token id
uint burned: cumulative burned counter
bool isBurnActive: gate for the burn function
GuestlistedArtProxy artProxyContract: external contract used to render token art
GuestlistedLibrary.Venue[] venues: storage of venue data indexed by token id ranges
GuestlistedLibrary.DJ[] djs: storage of dj data referenced by venues
mapping(string => uint) isTextColorWhite: background hex color to text color flag
mapping(uint => CustomAttribute[]) customAttributes: per token extra attributes
mapping(uint => CustomMetadata[]) customMetadata: per token extra metadata
mint(uint _nbTokens, bytes signature) payable nonReentrant: validates config, whitelist, holder status and wallet cap, then mints randomly or sequentially
burn(uint _tokenId) external: burns a token owned by the caller when burning is active
withdraw() external onlyOwner: transfers the whole contract balance to the owner
getRandomTokenIndex(address) internal: picks a shuffled random token index from mintCache/mintConfig.remaining
random(string) internal view: keccak256 over block.timestamp, block.difficulty and the input
deterministic(string) internal pure: keccak256 hashing of the input for deterministic traits
tokenURI(uint256) public view override: builds base64 JSON metadata including art from the proxy
getTokenData(uint256) private view: assembles venue, dj, date, color and shape data for a token
updateMintConfig(MintConfig) public onlyOwner: replaces the whole mint configuration
updateArtProxyContract(address) public onlyOwner: sets the external art proxy contract
updateWhitelistSigner(address) external onlyOwner: sets the whitelist signer address
updateVenue(int index, Venue) public onlyOwner: pushes or overwrites a venue
updateDJ(int index, DJ) public onlyOwner: pushes or overwrites a dj
updateCustomMetadata(uint[], CustomMetadata[]) external onlyOwner: rewrites per token metadata
updateCustomAttributes(uint[], CustomAttribute[]) external onlyOwner: rewrites per token attributes
flipBurnState() external onlyOwner: toggles isBurnActive
flipMintState() external onlyOwner: toggles mintConfig.isActive
tokensOfOwner(address) public view: enumerates token ids owned by an address
constructor: sets art proxy, mint config, venues, djs, white-text bgs and mints the owner reserve
payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance): ETH value transfer to the caller inside withdraw
_safeMint -> IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received external callback to the recipient contract
ECDSA.recover / ecrecover signature verification used for the whitelist signer check
totalSupply / minted / burned counter increments and decrements in mint and burn
mintConfig.remaining-- and mintCache index shuffling arithmetic in mint and getRandomTokenIndex
mint parameter _nbTokens: number of tokens requested per transaction
mint parameter signature: bytes signature checked against the whitelist signer
burn parameter _tokenId: token id to burn
local string minterKey: abi.encodePacked(_msgSender(), mintConfig.version) key into mintedPerWallet
local address recoveredSigner: result of the whitelist signature recovery
local uint randomNumber: random() output used to pick the mint index
local uint index: resolved token index returned by getRandomTokenIndex

edges.reason: mint derives the whitelist message, holder check, minterKey and mint recipient from _msgSender()
burn requires ownerOf(_tokenId) == _msgSender() before destroying the token
withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender() and sends funds to msg.sender
random() mixes block.timestamp into the pseudo-random number, making mint indices timestamp dependent
getRandomTokenIndex consumes the random() output to select a token index
getRandomTokenIndex reads mintConfig.remaining and mintConfig.startIndex and decrements remaining
getRandomTokenIndex reads and shuffles mintCache entries
mint reads isActive, mintPrice, limits, version, flags and remaining from mintConfig
mint enforces and increments mintedPerWallet[minterKey]
mint calls getRandomTokenIndex when the random mint strategy is active
mint invokes _safeMint which triggers the onERC721Received callback on recipient contracts
mint recovers the signer via ECDSA.recover/ecrecover and compares it with the whitelist signer
mint increments totalSupply and minted counters per minted token
mint decrements mintConfig.remaining and writes shuffled mintCache values
burn decrements totalSupply
burn increments the burned counter
burn is gated on the isBurnActive state variable
withdraw sends the entire contract balance to msg.sender via transfer
tokenURI fetches structured token data via getTokenData
tokenURI calls artProxyContract.draw to obtain the token image
tokenURI reads customMetadata entries to build the JSON
tokenURI reads customAttributes entries to build the JSON
getTokenData calls random() to compute the token randomNumber
getTokenData calls deterministic() for the deterministicNumber and shape selection
getTokenData iterates and reads venues to resolve the token venue
getTokenData reads djs through venue.djIndexes to resolve the dj
getTokenData reads isTextColorWhite to pick the text color
updateMintConfig overwrites the mintConfig state variable under onlyOwner
updateArtProxyContract assigns artProxyContract under onlyOwner
updateWhitelistSigner writes mintConfig.whitelistSigner under onlyOwner
updateVenue mutates the venues array under onlyOwner
updateDJ mutates the djs array under onlyOwner
updateCustomMetadata rewrites customMetadata entries under onlyOwner
updateCustomAttributes rewrites customAttributes entries under onlyOwner
flipBurnState toggles isBurnActive under onlyOwner
flipMintState toggles mintConfig.isActive under onlyOwner
tokensOfOwner sizes the result array from balanceOf and scans token ownership
constructor initializes mintConfig via updateMintConfig
constructor initializes artProxyContract via updateArtProxyContract
constructor mints the owner reserve using _safeMint which triggers the receiver callback

normalization_plan.reason: _nbTokens is a mint() parameter consumed directly by the mint function logic
signature is a mint() parameter consumed by the whitelist recovery inside mint
_tokenId is the burn() parameter validated and destroyed by burn
recoveredSigner is the local variable holding the ecrecover/ECDSA recovery result
randomNumber is the local variable holding the random() output consumed by getRandomTokenIndex
index is the local variable returned by getRandomTokenIndex as the chosen mint index
